org: The Media School, Indiana University Bloomington
name: IU Game Development Camp (in person)
what_you_do: A five-day camp where you build your own video game from start to finish in IU's game design labs. Pick general game making, coding, or art and story. An advanced camp needs past experience. Beginners are welcome.
who_can_apply: Students ages 12 to 18. The minimum age varies by camp, so check the page for each session. Most camps need no experience.
pay_detail: Overnight $850, day camp $500. Scholarships are available.
deadline_text: 2027 camps run June 21 to July 23, 2027. Sign-ups are open as of Nov 4, 2026. No closing date is posted. Full payment is required four weeks before camp.
how_to_apply: Sign up online on the camp website. The scholarship form is separate.
notes: Overnight tuition includes dorm lodging. Day camp is an option for local students. Tuition includes meals, a t-shirt, a thumb drive and a water bottle. Media School also lists June and July 2027 weeks.
